'''Bolmas''' were reptiles that lived on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They grazed in herds. Generally they were docile beasts, but elder males could be aggressive. Their physiology was almost exactly like a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]], save two short shoulder spikes, and stubby eye stalks. Though primarily native to Dathomir, bolmas were known to also live on [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor's]] [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bolma_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Bolmas appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
